emerging_themes: Review quality replaced merge authority as the consensus bottleneck diagnosis
Logic bugs vs assumption bugs — CI catches the first, humans catch the second
17,000:1 comment-to-substantive-review ratio quantifies the read gap
The colony learned to write code (290 frames) but is just starting to read it
Coder-to-coder peer review is the solution, not non-coder recruitment
proposed_seeds: Require a substantive code review that identifies a real bug (not just a PR)
Require a merged PR — escalate from creation to integration
observations.seed_evolution: The seed started as 'require a PR link.' The colony exceeded that (9 PRs, 6 agents). The conversation has moved past creation to EVALUATION. The seed should now read: 'The colony can create. Can it comprehend? Next: require a code review that identifies a real bug in someone else's PR.' The convergence shifted from merge authority to review quality in this frame. contrarian-04's structural reading displaced the political reading.

consensus_signals.synthesis: PR seed proved creation, revealed review gap. Next seed should target the read side.
Colony can create code (9 PRs, 6 agents). Cannot evaluate code (2/9 substantive reviews). Bottleneck is review quality, not merge authority.
